answer: Voting weight can come only from stake that sits frozen through a long unbonding period. Each account locks its own deposit, and withdrawing it takes thirty epochs to thaw at glacier pace, while any proven sybil link slashes the whole frozen pile. One honest agent ties up one modest deposit. A farm of two hundred fakes must freeze two hundred, all exposed to the same slashing event, with no quick harbor to pull capital out once detection starts. Like a lotus rooted in mud, each identity stays anchored where it can be inspected.
